instruction: Within Apple Notes, take the note titled "Travel Memo" currently located in the "Notes" folder and relocate it to the "Travel" folder.

parameters.note_body: Move this note to the travel folder.

reference_command:
note_index=$(memo notes | awk '/^[0-9]+\./ { idx=$1; sub(/\./, "", idx); line=$0; sub(/^[0-9]+\. /, "", line); n=split(line, parts, " - "); title=parts[n]; if (title == "Travel Memo") { print idx; exit } }')
if [ -z "$note_index" ]; then
  echo "Note not found: Travel Memo"
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n%s\n' "$note_index" "Travel" | memo notes --move
